label: Skool Scraper Pro
title: Skool Scraper Pro - Course & Community Data Extractor
metaDescription: Extract lessons, videos, posts, comments and community feeds from any Skool community, or discover communities by category or keyword. Resumes if interrupted.
intro: Discover Skool communities by keyword or category, then extract courses, lessons, posts, comments and community feeds. Download videos, attachments, PDFs and resources; interrupted runs resume automatically.
useCases: Back up the courses you bought, with videos and files
Index every lesson across your courses so you can search them
Research communities in a niche before you join or launch one

faq.q: Do I need to log in to Skool?
faq.a: Discovering communities works on public data. To extract a classroom you are a member of, you add your own Skool session cookie in the input; the actor never asks for your password.
